scope: Supplied app source only; no runtime or database access, no application changes

cases.observation: No failed-attempt limiting policy was found in the supplied login implementation or declared dependencies. Deployment-level controls were not evaluated.
cases.recommendation: Introduce a proportionate failed-login limiting policy.

cases.observation: The task-title rendering does not preserve the default HTML output-encoding control.
cases.recommendation: Preserve automatic output encoding for task titles.

cases.observation: The reviewed API search query construction does not consistently apply parameter binding.
cases.recommendation: Use bound parameters for all user-supplied database query values.

cases.observation: Both registration paths use the framework password-hashing function, save the returned hash and verify passwords using the framework verification function. The schema stores a password hash. Actual database contents and cryptographic strength were not evaluated.
cases.recommendation: Retain framework-supported password hashing and review configuration during deployment.
